name: Parkinson Disease
definition: Progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized clinically by bradykinesia with rigidity and/or rest tremor, plus a range of non-motor symptoms.

redFlags.item: Early severe falls or gaze palsy suggesting atypical parkinsonism

investigations.MRI: MRI is used when atypical features suggest alternative disease.

green: Exercise, balance, gait and speech therapy
amber: Medication changes can cause major motor/non-motor effects and require specialist supervision.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kampavata is a commonly discussed Ayurvedic correlation; modern Parkinson diagnosis/staging remains explicit.

patientEducation.summary: Progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized clinically by bradykinesia with rigidity and/or rest tremor, plus a range of non-motor symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
